message: You're lucky to have such a friend. Honesty is hardly forthcoming from all fronts.  Been thinking a lot about pride lately, absorbed as I am in Spenser (and that dumb ole RCK) so not interested in claiming it, but am intrigued; figured you'd forgotten about me and all.  I don't know what I'll have to do to bury my association with "Phlebas" other than come up w/something better.
